itens.trecho: Um bom filme sobre uma das grandes bandas rock do século XX. Este é um daqueles filmes que foi feito a pensar nos fãs de uma personalidade, mais do que no resto do público.
A good film about one of the great rock bands of the 20th century. This is one of those films that was made with the fans of a personality in mind, more than the rest of the public.

I was scared to see this, mainly because most Biopics paint people in an absolutely horrible light and Queen was one of my favorite bands and Freddie one of my favorite rock vocalists. I was ready to rant and rave if it turned out to be a smear campaign of one of my rock heroes. Fortunately it wasn't, it was actually a fair treatment of all of them.
